summary: Removed the four unsupported recognition items, replaced the other off-booklet practice and quiz tasks with cited specified-unit conversions using new values, and repaired the mixed abbreviation task as a numerical capacity conversion. Preserved the supported items and existing theory and worked examples, retained the tier minimums and remaining quiz ids, and calculated every replacement answer and distractor from its stated method or mistake.
reviewSummary: All 26 requested final items have correct answers, suitable working and booklet-supported question types; every reviewed quiz has exactly one correct option and accurate distractor explanations. The theory is usable without mandatory changes, and all four removals are justified by the booklet question-type rule.
